member.name: T:Diti365.Domain.DomainException
member.summary: Raised by the application and infrastructure layers when a business rule is violated. The exception middleware maps and straight into an RFC 7807 response.

member.name: M:Diti365.Domain.DomainException.Validation(System.String)
member.summary: A request the caller can fix by sending different values. 400 rather than 422 because these are malformed inputs, not rule violations - a client retrying the same body unchanged will always fail.
